nashvillemta._note: CIV-536: one fall feed a year. 2015-2023 from the OpenMobilityData (TransitFeeds) archive, 2024-2026 from the Mobility Database (mdb-360). Each period reads the first full October week of its year (manager, 2026-11-18: match existing History, mostly Sep-Dec). Research: Atlas-worktrees/_reports/CIV-536-wego-history.md.

kingston._note: CIV-1863: the 2016 period only (the other Kingston periods are already v2 sidecars, CIV-437). Mobility Database mdb-733 = the OpenMobilityData city-of-kingston/779 archive; dataset 20161102 holds the Sep 6 - Dec 30, 2016 timetable. No anchor month: Sep's first full week starts before the zip, so the vote picks the week of 2016-09-12.

indygo._note: CIV-2059: IndyGo 2015-2022 from the OpenMobilityData indygo/210 archive (reached through the Mobility Database's ntd-50050 dataset list; mdb-1237 only has 2023-era files). One zip per published v1 period key, each checked to hold a weekday timetable around its key date. No anchor month: the vote picks the first full week in force (refDates 2015-10-07 to 2022-10-12, each in its own year). 2021 is in the Atlas archive (20211009), not here.
